title: 二号人事部接入
description: 填写智能分身 Key 以连接二号人事部。凭证仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录下，不经过云端。该 Key 在 ucenter 的接口白名单决定连接后可见与可调用的工具集合。
description_en: Enter your HR Key to connect. Credentials are stored locally only and never leave your machine. The key's API whitelist in ucenter determines which tools are visible and callable.

fields.label: 智能分身 Key
fields.placeholder: 在 ucenter 智能分身配置处生成
fields.description: 用于换取业务 Token 与接口白名单的个人访问密钥。授权范围由该 Key 在 ucenter 的接口白名单决定。
fields.description_en: Personal access key used to exchange for a business token and API whitelist. Its scope is governed by the key's API whitelist in ucenter.
